experiments.notice_desc: When enabled, memories are graded as setting / habit / event and may be summarized, degraded, or forgotten over time. With the master switch off there are no side effects. Keep dry-run on until you have reviewed the proposals.
experiments.master_desc: When off, the backend does not parse, call models, or change injected content.
experiments.enable_desc: Sub-switches apply after this is on. Data produced by the experiment is still read through a safe view when switched off: superseded or tombstoned memories never come back.
experiments.dry_run_desc: Only generates merge / degrade / purge proposals and audit records; no memory is modified. Turning this off executes approved changes, which cannot be undone.
experiments.capabilities_desc: Each capability is independent; all are inactive while the master switch is off.
experiments.structured_intake_desc: Store memories with time / place / person / event facets and classify them as setting, habit, or event. Anything the user explicitly asks to remember is protected at setting level.
experiments.compaction_candidates_desc: After context compaction, extract structured memory candidates from the compressed originals. They only enter the pending queue; the context summary itself is unchanged.
experiments.merge_proposals_desc: Use person, event, and tags to detect overwrites (Remilia → Patchouli), completions (reminder done), and same-topic merges (strawberries + watermelon).
experiments.mention_scoring_desc: Every user mention raises a memory's score. High-score memories are protected from second-round degradation; repeatedly mentioned events can be promoted to habits.
experiments.maintenance_desc: On startup, due memories get a degradation proposal: low-weight events about every 7 days, high-score habits about every 14 days. New summaries re-enter scoring.
experiments.status_recall_desc: Only active memories are recalled; questions about now and about the past use different temporal routes. Superseded versions are no longer injected.
experiments.dynamic_recall_desc: Recall memories for the latest user message and append them after the history. Never frozen, never rewrites the history prefix, so the cache stays intact.
experiments.llm_assist_desc: Send merge decisions and degradation summaries to the memory model under Models › Scene models. Better wording, but real requests and cost. When off, only deterministic rules are used.
experiments.auto_apply_safe_desc: Only clearly completed reminders may be removed automatically after dry-run is off. Everything else still needs manual approval, and every change is audited.
experiments.merge_desc: Scans memories by person, tags and completion markers. Scanning only writes audit entries; memories change only after approval with dry-run off.
experiments.merge_empty: No pending proposals. Scan again after memories change.
experiments.merge_disabled_hint: Enable "First-round merge proposals" to use this panel.
experiments.merge_dry_run_hint: Dry-run: you can reject now; approving requires turning dry-run off.
experiments.promotion_desc: When the same kind of event repeats across conversations, a pending event → habit proposal is created. Proposals only write audit records; nothing is reclassified until approved with dry-run off.
experiments.promotion_disabled_hint: Enable "Mention scoring" to use this panel.
experiments.promotion_dry_run_hint: Dry-run: you can reject now; approving requires turning dry-run off.
experiments.maintenance_panel_desc: Runs once shortly after startup, or on demand — no resident timer. Plans are audit-only; applying them and the due purge require dry run to be off.
experiments.maintenance_empty: No due maintenance plans. Check again after memories change or the cadence elapses.
experiments.maintenance_disabled_hint: The main experiment switch is off. Turn it on to use this panel.
experiments.maintenance_cost: Applying these plans would call the model {{calls}} time(s) (~{{tokens}} tokens); only fidelity summaries call the memory model — coarsen and theme merge write the preview shown here, locally.
experiments.maintenance_toast_applied: Distillation applied; the original is kept and can be undone during the grace period
experiments.maintenance_apply_hint: Dry-run: check and review plans first; applying requires turning dry-run off. The result is exactly the preview above — nothing is rewritten at apply time.
experiments.maintenance_undo_hint: Undo is available during the grace period; once the original is purged it closes.
experiments.forget_summary: {{raw}} original(s) due for purge · {{tombstones}} theme(s) due for tombstone · {{scheduled}} scheduled
experiments.forget_purge_toast: Purged {{raw}} original(s); {{tombstones}} theme(s) turned into tombstones
experiments.forget_purge_confirm_desc: Deletes the originals of {{raw}} due memories; {{tombstones}} L3 theme(s) will be tombstoned together with their content. Message originals are untouched, but the purge cannot be undone.
experiments.unlock_desc: Distillation rewrites and the {{days}}-day due purge will then really run, and expired deletions cannot be undone. Make a full backup first and confirm you have checked at least one round of maintenance plans.
experiments.unlock_confirm: I have a backup — turn it off
experiments.rhythm_desc: These values only affect the experiment and never change the existing compaction or injection budgets.
experiments.hot_mention_threshold_desc: Memories mentioned at least this many times are hot and skip second-round degradation.
experiments.event_distill_days_desc: How often low-score event memories get a degradation proposal.
experiments.habit_distill_days_desc: How often high-score habits or frequently mentioned events get a degradation proposal.
experiments.purge_after_days_desc: How long the original content is kept after degradation before real deletion. 0 means never purge automatically.
experiments.max_candidates_desc: Maximum memory candidates extracted per compaction. 0 records the event without extracting.
experiments.dynamic_recall_top_k_desc: How many memories are recalled and appended for the latest message.
experiments.footer: Experiment data stays on this machine. Android / Kelivo exports keep only active memories; experiment-only fields are stripped.

memory.write_strategy_subtitle: Only applies to assistants created afterwards; existing assistants are configured below.
memory.global_subtitle: Shared memories that apply to every assistant.
memory.assistant_subtitle: Only apply within the matching assistant's chats.
memory.empty_assistant: This assistant has no memories yet.
memory.write_strategy_title: Default write scope for new assistants
memory.dedup_enable_desc: Compare new memories with existing ones first: exact duplicates are skipped, related entries are merged. Requires a model in Models › Scene models › Memory model; without one, only exact duplicates are skipped.
memory.dedup_thinking_desc: Enable reasoning for models that support it: more accurate, but slower and more expensive.
memory.organize_need_model: No memory model configured: pick a chat model in Models › Scene models › Memory model first.
memory.organize_skipped: Nothing was organized: conditions not met.
memory.organize_skipped_too_few_memories: Fewer than 2 memories; nothing to organize.
memory.organize_skipped_below_threshold: The configured number of turns has not been reached.
memory.organize_skipped_model_call_failed: The memory model call failed. Try again later.
memory.organize_none: No memories needed merging or removal.
memory.batch_confirm: Replace all? This overwrites current memories (.bak auto-backed up).
memory.tombstone_placeholder: (This memory was cleared by the forgetting policy; only its audit record remains)
memory.global_agents_subtitle: Personal instructions (AGENTS.md) applied to every workspace session: communication preferences, habitual workflows and so on. Complements memory — memory holds facts the model extracts, this is what you write yourself. Each workspace can also have its own AGENTS.md; both apply together.
memory.global_agents_active: Active: applies to every workspace session
memory.global_agents_inactive: Not created yet. Once created, it applies to every workspace session.
memory.global_agents_create_hint: Creates the global instruction file, applied to every workspace session.
memory.global_agents_edit_hint: Edit the global instructions. The next workspace session reads the new content.
memory.vector_subtitle: Once enabled, memories are indexed by an embedding model and only relevant ones are injected at the start of a conversation.
memory.vector_enable_desc: Memories are indexed by an embedding model; only relevant ones are injected at the start of a conversation.
memory.vector_embedding_model_desc: Chosen under Models › Scene models; shared with knowledge bases and other semantic features.
memory.vector_not_configured: No usable embedding model yet: choose an OpenAI-compatible embedding model under Scene models before enabling.
memory.vector_enable_confirm_desc: {{n}} memories need indexing (about {{tokens}} tokens). New memories are embedded automatically; click "Fill missing" below for existing ones.
memory.vector_rebuild_confirm_desc: {{n}} memories will be embedded (about {{tokens}} tokens). New memories are embedded automatically afterwards.
memory.vector_clear_confirm_desc: Only vectors are deleted — memories stay. Recall falls back to full injection until re-indexed.
memory.vector_cancel_requested: Cancellation requested; finished batches are kept
memory.vector_preview_hint: Calls the embedding model once per click (may incur a small cost).
memory.vector_auto_index_desc: Embed memories after they are written or edited; when off, new memories wait for the next "Fill missing".
memory.vector_min_memories_desc: When visible memories do not exceed this count, all of them are injected and no query embedding is made (0–200).
memory.vector_expand_neighbors_desc: Also inject memories semantically close to the selected ones (local computation only).
memory.vector_rerank_unconfigured: No rerank model configured; choose one under Scene models first.

general.ui_font_size_hint: Scale the font size and spacing of the entire app. Everything scales proportionally without breaking the layout.
general.tray_desc: What happens when you close the main window.
general.minimize_to_tray_hint: Hides the window to the system tray on close; background tasks keep running. Click the tray icon to restore. Quit completely from the tray menu.
general.shell_path_placeholder: Leave empty to auto-detect (system Git Bash or built-in terminal)
general.shell_path_hint: The bash the AI uses to run commands. Leave empty to auto-detect; if detection fails, point to a full bash.exe path here (e.g. Cygwin/MSYS2).
general.shell_path_invalid: Invalid path: point to an existing bash.exe

opt.collapse_all_steps: Collapse all thinking and tool steps

general.long_text_desc: When a single pasted or dropped plain-text block exceeds the threshold, it is uploaded as a .txt attachment instead of being inserted, keeping the composer responsive.
general.long_text_as_file_hint: When off, long text goes straight into the composer; very long text may cause lag.
general.long_text_threshold_hint: Range 500–50000 characters; only longer text is converted.
general.subagent_desc: Dispatch parallel subtasks to subagents with isolated contexts. Subagents follow the same workspace boundary and approval policy and can read and write files.
general.subagent_enabled_hint: When on, the model can see and call the subagent dispatch tool. When off, leftover calls from history are rejected.
general.subagent_max_concurrency_hint: Upper bound on subagents running at once ({{min}}–{{max}}).
general.subagent_token_budget_hint: Total token budget across all subtasks of one dispatch ({{min}}–{{max}}). Tasks that have not started are skipped once it runs out.
general.subagent_tools_hint: Only checked tools are exposed in subagent contexts.

providers.name: Provider name
providers.get_key_title: Go to the provider's website to get an API key
providers.history_reasoning_desc: Newer models (e.g. DeepSeek V4) require reasoning_content to be echoed back. When enabled, the reasoning_content of past assistant messages is sent with each request; models that don't need it ignore the field silently. Turn this off if a provider rejects requests over the unrecognized field.
providers.prompt_cache_desc: When enabled, adds cache_control to the system prompt and the second-to-last user message to reuse Anthropic's prompt cache.
providers.prompt_cache_key_desc: Attach a per-conversation prompt_cache_key so official OpenAI endpoints can route requests of the same conversation to the same cache shard, improving cache hits. Some third-party endpoints may reject this field; enable as needed.
providers.interactions_desc: Route chat requests through Google's Interactions endpoint (next-generation protocol with thinking summaries, signed function calls, and image output). When off, the standard generateContent endpoint is used; only the official Gemini endpoint supports it.
providers.custom_headers_desc: Attached to every request of this provider (chat, model list, balance lookup, etc.). When the same header is also set at the assistant or model level, this provider-level value has the lowest priority.
providers.models_desc: Fetch the provider's models first, then check the ones to enable. {{count}} currently enabled.
providers.add_model_title: Add a model manually (for custom models not in the upstream list)
providers.no_models: No models yet. Click “Add model” to add one manually, or “Fetch models” to sync from upstream.
providers.tool_enabled: Tool calling is enabled — click to disable
providers.reasoning_enabled: Reasoning is enabled — click to disable
providers.test_model_ph: Fetch the model list or pick an enabled model first
providers.balance_desc: GETs the balance at the path below and reads the value from the specified JSON path.
providers.balance_result_path_invalid: Invalid expression. Supports paths (e.g. data.total_credits, list[0]) and + - * / ++ operators.
providers.non_chat_test_note: Embedding and rerank models never touch chat/completions. The check sends one tiny request to the matching endpoint (a short sentence, or two short documents) — billed like the chat probe.

providers.key_required_enable: Fill in an API Key before enabling and fetching the model list
providers.no_models_enable: No models returned — can't enable. Check the provider config.
providers.enable_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch models, not enabled

oauth.not_signed_in: Sign in with your subscription — no API Key required

oauth.waiting_device_code: Open the link below to complete sign-in

assistants.name: Assistant name
assistants.system_prompt_cache_hint: Note: the cur_time / cur_datetime / time variables are second-precision and change on every request, which prevents prompt cache hits. Prefer the day-level cur_date unless needed.
assistants.copy_desc: "{{name}}" has {{n}} own memories. Copy them to the new assistant as well?
assistants.delete_confirm_with_memories: Delete the assistant "{{name}}"? It has {{n}} memories.
assistants.message_template_desc: Wraps the user message before sending it to the model. Usually fine to leave as default.
assistants.template_missing_warn: The template doesn't contain {{token}}, so user messages won't be sent to the model.
assistants.preview_assistant_response: Hello, how can I help you?
assistants.preset_messages_desc: These preset messages are written when a new conversation is created, giving the assistant a stable opening context.
assistants.regex_desc: Runs substitutions after user input or assistant output; invalid regexes are skipped automatically.
assistants.param_default_desc: Not set: the parameter is omitted and the model default applies. Drag or type a value to set it.
assistants.max_tokens_desc: Leave empty to omit it and use the server default.
assistants.context_message_desc: Controls how many historical messages are sent to the model as context. Messages beyond this number are ignored; only the most recent ones are kept, saving tokens. 0 or blank means unlimited.
assistants.local_tools_desc: Local tool list. When enabled, they're injected only if the current model supports tool calls.
assistants.memory_desc: Reading and writing are controlled per assistant.
assistants.memory_enable_desc: Read this assistant's memories and let the model propose new ones. Whether global memory can be written is still governed by the main switch on the Memory page.
assistants.memory_write_scope_desc: Model-chooses scopes pass a scope argument to the model; fixed scopes ignore the model's choice.
assistants.memory_auto_organize_desc: After every N turns, let the memory model merge duplicates. Requires a model in Models › Scene models › Memory model; nothing runs without one.

time_info.title: Time info
time_info.desc: Reads the local time, timezone, weekday and timestamp.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.desc: Read/write the system clipboard; the model shouldn't write unless explicitly asked.

tts.title: Text to speech
tts.desc: Reads text aloud via the system voice.

ask_user.title: Ask user
ask_user.desc: Shows a question in the chat for the user to answer before continuing.

assistants.headers_desc: Appended to request headers when sending model requests.
assistants.bodies_desc: Merged into the request body by key; the value can be JSON or a plain string.
assistants.empty: No assistants yet. Click "Add assistant" to create one.
assistants.delete_memories_desc: Kept memories become orphaned and can be managed on the Memory page.

proxy.ua_desc: Customize the User-Agent header sent with outbound requests. Leave blank to use the default. Only change this if your provider (e.g. a corporate gateway or API relay) requires a specific User-Agent.
proxy.none_detected_desc: The system proxy is off, or the proxy tool hasn't started yet.
proxy.pac_detected_desc: This app does not support PAC scripts. Check your proxy tool for its HTTP proxy port and fill in the address manually (e.g. 127.0.0.1:7890).
proxy.port_invalid: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
proxy.port_8080_desc: 8080 is often taken by reverse proxies, dev servers or router admin pages; on conflict the app may fail to start or fall back to another port. Consider an uncommon port (e.g. 18080). You can still keep 8080.
proxy.port_restart_note: After clicking Save, restart the app for the port to take effect. The running instance still uses the old port.
proxy.port_container_locked: In container deployments the port is decided by the image and docker -p mapping; changing it here has no effect.
proxy.restart_failed: Restart failed. Please quit and reopen the app manually.
proxy.socks_not_supported: SOCKS proxy is not supported (runtime limitation). Please use the proxy tool's HTTP port.
proxy.mode_auto_desc: Automatically follow the system proxy (Windows registry / GNOME settings).
proxy.mode_manual_desc: Use the fixed HTTP proxy specified below.
proxy.mode_direct_desc: Ignore the system proxy entirely; all requests go direct (an escape hatch when the system proxy is broken).
proxy.mode_env_desc: Controlled by HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY environment variables (common in container deployments).
proxy.env_desktop_hint: In the desktop app, please use Manual mode — Env mode only applies to Docker deployments; the desktop app clears proxy environment variables at startup, so this mode always connects directly.
proxy.container_mode_desc: Container deployment: the proxy is controlled by docker environment variables (HTTPS_PROXY, etc.) and cannot be changed here. Configure it in docker-compose or docker run.
proxy.bypass_rules_desc: Matching hosts connect directly without the proxy (localhost / 127.0.0.1 always bypass). Comma-separated; *.example.com wildcards and 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR ranges supported.
proxy.url_invalid: Invalid proxy URL. Expected http(s)://host:port or host:port.

stats.t_cache_hit_rate_tip: Hits {{cached}} / provider-reported input {{reported}} (local estimates excluded to avoid diluting the ratio)
stats.heatmap_empty: No chat data yet. The heatmap appears once you start chatting.

search.request_url_hint: Leave empty for the official endpoint; set a relay or reverse-proxy address
search.request_url_hint_selfhost: Enter the instance address, e.g. https://search.example.com
search.request_url_bad_scheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://
search.api_key_hint: One key per box; click + to add more. Auto-switches to the next key on failure

models.note: Lists the available models from enabled providers. Pick a model for each scene; for scenes with a prompt, use the button on the right to view or restore the default.
models.scene_empty: No models to choose from yet: first mark a model's type as “{{type}}” under Models › Providers.

compress_engine.pi_note: The workspace engine uses pi's native compaction. This prompt ships with the engine and is read-only. Incremental updates and oversized turns use dedicated variants of the same scheme.

chat.title: Primary model
chat.desc: The main model for conversations and work tasks. Used when no model is manually selected on the home page.

optimize.title: Prompt optimization
optimize.desc: The model used by the “Optimize prompt” button. It rewrites your draft more clearly and professionally based on context. When unset, it follows the current conversation's primary model.

fast.title: Fast model
fast.desc: A lightweight model for generating conversation titles and chat suggestions

translate.title: Translation
translate.desc: The model used for translation. When unset, it follows the current conversation's primary model.

compress.title: Context compression
compress.desc: The model for compressing long conversations, keeping key context and writing it back to the conversation. When unset, it follows the current conversation's primary model.
compress.auto_desc: Before a chat reply, automatically compress once when the context approaches the model limit. This calls the compression model above and may incur usage costs. When off, you'll only be reminded to compress manually.

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.desc: A fallback image-to-text channel for chat models without vision input. When unset, this channel is unavailable.

image.title: Image generation
image.desc: Entry point for models with image generation capability. Image generation is unavailable until a model is set.

embedding.title: Embedding model
embedding.desc: The global tier that encodes text into vectors via the /embeddings endpoint. Only models of the embedding type are listed. When unset, related features are unavailable.

rerank.title: Rerank model
rerank.desc: The global tier that re-scores retrieved candidates via the /rerank endpoint. When unset, results keep their original ranking.

memory.title: Memory model
memory.desc: The chat model used to deduplicate memory writes and to organize memories periodically. When unset, dedup only skips exact duplicates and auto organize never runs.

mcp.no_assistants: No assistants to configure yet. Create one on the Assistants page first, then come back here.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.priority_hint: When several apply at once, higher values are injected first.
mcp.inject_depth_hint: Counting back from the latest message, insert before this one.
mcp.scan_depth_hint: Only match keywords within the most recent N messages.

health_notify.config_error: MCP server misconfigured — check it in Settings

oauth.desc: Some MCP servers require OAuth 2.1 sign-in. Authorization happens in your system browser; tokens are stored locally only.
oauth.browser_opened: Authorization page opened in browser; this status will update automatically once done
oauth.clear_confirm: Clear OAuth authorization for this server?

server.detail_desc: When enabled, it connects and syncs tools/list automatically; the home-page MCP picker decides whether the current assistant uses it.
server.url_desc: The Streamable HTTP endpoint of the MCP server.
server.headers_desc: Attached to every connection and call, typically for API key auth.
server.command_desc: Executable to run locally as the current user (npx, uvx, or an absolute script path). Only run commands you trust.
server.args_desc: One argument per line, passed to the command in order.
server.cwd_desc: Optional. Defaults to RikkaHub's working directory when empty.
server.env_desc: Injected into the spawned process, typically for API keys and other credentials.
server.tools_count: {{count}} tools — enable each one and choose whether it needs your approval.
server.tools_empty: Tools are synced automatically once enabled and saved.

mcp.constant_active_desc: Ignore keywords and inject this entry in every conversation.
mcp.keywords_hint: Press Enter to add; triggers when any keyword appears in the chat.
mcp.keywords_disabled_ph: No keywords needed when always active
mcp.keywords_ph: Type a keyword and press Enter
mcp.no_entries: No entries yet. Click “Add entry” to start.

lorebook.desc_ph: (optional) describe what this lorebook is for
lorebook.page_desc: A set of keyword-triggered entries: when the chat mentions a keyword, its entry is injected into the context.

quick.title: Title
quick.page_desc: Frequently used text you can drop into the input box from the quick message menu.
quick.title_hint: Shown in the quick message menu.
quick.content_hint: Filled into the input box when picked; you can edit it before sending.

mcp.inject_content_template_ph: Injection content, supports template variables like {{cur_datetime}}
mcp.mode_page_desc: Inserts a fixed prompt at the chosen position — for writing styles, personas and the like.
mcp.global_enable_desc: When off, it applies to no assistant, regardless of "Enable for this assistant".
mcp.skill_global_failed: Failed to enable for all assistants
mcp.skill_page_desc: A specialised playbook for the AI, loaded on demand during chats.
mcp.skill_empty_detail: No skills yet. Use "Add" on the left to create one, or import from GitHub or a file.
mcp.skill_md_desc: The name and description at the top define the skill and when to use it; the body is the instruction for the AI.
mcp.skill_unavailable_hint: description is missing, so the AI engine will not load this skill (add it to the SKILL.md frontmatter)
mcp.import_github_desc: Accepts a repository root, or a subdirectory link like /tree/branch/sub/path.
mcp.file_list_desc: Scripts and resources shipped in the skill folder, read by the AI on demand.
mcp.skill_desc_default: Describe when this skill should be used
mcp.binding_assistant_desc: "Enable for this assistant" below controls whether the selected assistant uses each item.
mcp.transport_desc: Streamable HTTP connects to a remote endpoint (OAuth supported); local stdio launches a process on this machine. HTTP+SSE is retired and old configs migrate automatically.

import.title: Import MCP configuration from JSON
import.desc: Supports Claude Desktop / VS Code / Cline mcpServers or servers structures, plus a single server object. Imported servers stay disabled until you review and enable them.
import.imported: Imported {{count}} MCP server(s), disabled by default

im.intro: Messages from these channels spend your own model quota, and the assistant's system prompt and memory are visible to anyone you pair.
im.qq_desc: Bind once, then message the bot in QQ. The gateway connection is direct and ignores the Proxy page settings.
im.qq_enabled_desc: Turning this off disconnects the gateway; credentials are kept.
im.qq_credentials_unbound: Not bound yet. Click Bind and scan the code with mobile QQ.
im.wechat_desc: Bind once, then message the bot in WeChat. Requests follow the Proxy page settings.
im.wechat_enabled_desc: Turning this off stops receiving messages; credentials are kept.
im.wechat_credentials_unbound: Not bound yet. Click Bind and scan the code with WeChat.
im.assistant_desc: Which assistant persona and model answer on this channel.
im.workspace_desc: New conversations on this channel run inside this workspace: the assistant can read and write its files and run commands, limited by the workspace preset. Only affects conversations created afterwards; existing ones keep their setup, and /new starts a fresh one.
im.qq_plaintext_desc: QQ does not render Markdown. When on, replies sent to QQ drop **, #, list bullets and code fences while keeping kaomoji and emoji intact. The conversation on the desktop keeps the original content.
im.wechat_plaintext_desc: When on, replies sent to WeChat drop Markdown syntax while keeping kaomoji and emoji intact. The conversation on the desktop keeps the original content.
im.unbind_desc: Saved credentials are cleared and messages stop. Existing conversations are kept.
im.qq_bind_desc: Scan the code with mobile QQ and confirm. The bot starts working as soon as binding finishes.
im.wechat_bind_desc: Scan the code with WeChat and confirm.
im.bind_success: Bound. Messages are now coming in.
im.bind_expired: The code expired. Refresh it and scan again.
im.qr_unavailable: Could not render the QR image; use the link below to finish binding.
im.pairing_desc: Messages from strangers are rejected by default. Generate a 6-character code and send it to them privately; they reply with it to get access. One code, one person, valid for an hour.
im.pairing_enabled_desc: When off, nobody new can pair: messages from strangers are rejected and any active pairing code is revoked. People already authorized are unaffected.
im.pairing_none: No active pairing code. Generate one when someone else should use the assistant on this machine.
im.paired_desc: Their messages go straight to the assistant without a pairing code.
im.paired_empty: Nobody has been authorized with a pairing code yet.
im.unpair_desc: They will need to pair again before sending messages.
im.chats_desc: Each IM chat maps to a local conversation, visible and continuable on the desktop.
im.chat_unbind_desc: Only the mapping is removed; the local conversation is kept. The next message from them starts a new conversation.

ssh.title: SSH
ssh.empty_detail: Add a device, then fill in host, username and authentication to connect.
ssh.page_desc: Connect to a remote machine for maintenance. Connections are pooled and reused; the trusted host key and the authorized directories decide what this app may reach.
ssh.name: Name
ssh.test_hint: Tests the values currently in the form — no need to wait for autosave.
ssh.required_hint: Fill in host, username and credentials first.
ssh.password_hint: Stored in local state.json alongside model API keys; never written to logs.
ssh.private_key_hint: Paste the full OpenSSH / PEM private key; passphrase-protected keys are supported.
ssh.passphrase_hint: Leave empty if the key is not encrypted.
ssh.console_desc: Commands run inside an authorized directory (or the login default) and return the exit code plus stdout / stderr.
ssh.command_hint: Runs non-interactively and returns the exit code plus stdout / stderr.
ssh.live_connection_hint: Connections are reused across actions and closed automatically after 5 minutes idle.
ssh.console_dir_hint: Only directories authorized below can be selected; "No directory" runs in the login shell's default location.
ssh.host_key_desc: The server key you have confirmed. A connection to an unconfirmed server is refused before your credentials are ever sent.
ssh.host_key_trusted_hint: Saved with the device. If the server presents a different key next time, the connection stops until you confirm again.
ssh.host_key_untrusted_hint: Testing the connection will show the key this server presents and ask you to confirm it.
ssh.host_key_pending: Waiting for first contact — the key is confirmed when you test the connection.
ssh.dirs_desc: The only paths this app may touch on the remote machine. The file panel, the terminal and workspace bindings all pick from this list.
ssh.dirs_empty: No directories yet. Commands can still run, but file browsing, the terminal and workspace binding need at least one.
ssh.dir_path_hint: Absolute path, e.g. /srv/app. A blank path is kept as a draft and stays out of every picker.
ssh.dir_delete_desc: File panels, terminals and workspaces bound to it stop working right away. Nothing is deleted on the remote machine.
ssh.trust_desc_new: This server has not been trusted yet. Compare the fingerprint below against the machine itself before connecting.
ssh.trust_desc_changed: This server presented a different key from the one you trusted. It may have been reinstalled, or someone is intercepting the connection. Do not continue unless you can explain the change.
ssh.trust_verify: Verify it on the server with
ssh.trust_warning: Trusting this key stores it with the device, and the next attempt sends your credentials to this server.
ssh.trust_failed: Failed to save the trusted key

speech.read_filter_desc: Preprocess text before narration to skip parts you don't want to hear.
speech.only_read_quoted_desc: Read only the lines inside quotes, skipping narration and action descriptions (great for role-play).
speech.skip_brackets_desc: Skip notes, tone and stage directions inside Chinese/English brackets.
speech.asr_empty: No speech recognition services yet. Click Add to configure one.
speech.name: Name
speech.silence_duration_desc: Duration used to decide the end of speech.
speech.select_asr: Select or add a speech recognition service.
speech.tts_empty: No speech synthesis services yet. Click Add to configure one.
speech.test_title: Read a test sentence using the current config
speech.test_text: This is a test voice to verify the current TTS configuration.
speech.test_system_done: Test text played via system voice
speech.elevenlabs_stability_desc: Stability: lower is more expressive, higher is more consistent.
speech.elevenlabs_similarity_desc: Similarity boost: higher stays closer to the source voice.
speech.step_instruction_desc: Omitted when empty; step-tts-mini / vivid ignore this field.
speech.fish_reference_desc: reference_id of a cloned voice; leave empty for the default voice.
speech.fish_temperature_desc: Sampling temperature; higher is more random.
speech.volc_resource_desc: Must match the service and voice enabled in the console; default seed-tts-2.0. Note: use the Doubao Speech console API key, not the Volcano Ark one.
speech.volc_speaker_desc: Fill in the voice ID from the console; defaults to the VV voice.
speech.volc_rate_desc: Range -50 to 100; 0 is normal, -50 half speed, 100 double speed.
speech.system_pitch_desc: System voice pitch can't be adjusted directly; this setting is exported with the config only.
speech.select_tts: Select or add a speech synthesis service.
speech.tts_detail_desc: {{type}} · "Read aloud" under messages uses the current service.
speech.asr_detail_desc: {{type}} · Voice input in the chat box uses the current service, transcribed over a realtime WebSocket or a segmented HTTP endpoint.
speech.segment_duration_desc: MiMo has no server-side realtime endpoint; audio is uploaded in segments of this length. 0 uploads everything when recording stops.
speech.mimo_realtime_title: MiMo cannot be used for hands-free voice
speech.mimo_realtime_desc: MiMo only provides segmented HTTP transcription with no server-side end-of-speech detection, so it cannot drive voice mode (the phone button) and is blocked there. It still works for dictation in the chat input.
speech.language_hint: Language code such as zh or en; leave empty to auto-detect.
speech.prompt_hint: Add proper nouns or domain terms to improve accuracy.

media.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Any default model referencing it will stop working.
media.empty: No media services yet. Add a provider to generate images or videos in chat.
media.name: Service name
media.detail_desc: {{type}} · type cannot be changed after creation
media.type_immutable: The type determines capabilities and the default URL. Create a new service to switch.
media.workspace_required: WorkspaceId is required while the URL contains {WorkspaceId}
media.workspace_hint: {WorkspaceId} in the URL is replaced with the WorkspaceId below.
media.workspace_id_hint: Aliyun Bailian workspace ID, e.g. ws-xxxxxxxx.
media.models_desc: Only enter model IDs supported by the provider; choose image or video for each.
media.restore_confirm: Restore the default URL and models for "{{name}}"? The current model list will be replaced.
media.presets_unavailable: Presets are unavailable; check the server connection.
media.fetched_hint: Tick the models to add. Image/video kinds are guessed from the model ID — adjust them in the list above.
media.fetch_needs_credentials: Fill in the Base URL and API Key before fetching the model list
media.storage_desc: Used only by endpoints that need a public image URL (video reference media); separate from the backup S3.
media.path_style_desc: Usually required by MinIO and similar; can be off for AWS S3.
media.storage_test_desc: Sends one list request to verify the config; no generation fees.
media.defaults_desc: Pre-selected when media generation is enabled in a new conversation; each conversation can override.
media.defaults_note: Only models from providers with a key and URL are listed.
media.video_s3_warning: Video reference media needs upload storage; video requests with references will fail without it.

data.extracting: Upload done, extracting and importing data...
data.pack_slow: With many attachments, packing may take tens of seconds. Please wait.
data.extract_slow: Parsing chat history from a large backup may take a few minutes. Don't close the app.
data.no_schema_warn: Note: the mobile app's database format hasn't been captured yet, so backups won't include conversations. Click "Export backup" under Local backup & restore to register the format.
data.restore_confirm: Restoring {{name}} overwrites your current local settings, conversations and logs. Continue?
data.s3_restore_confirm: Restore from the remote backup {{name}}? This overwrites the current local state.
data.register_ok: Mobile app database schema registered (version {{version}}, hash {{hash}}...)
data.register_note: Note: this needs to be done once on first use. Re-register after the mobile app updates.
data.export_done:
Backup exported: {{name}}
Find it in your browser's default download folder.
data.import_confirm: Importing overwrites the current local settings, conversations and logs. Continue?
data.import_network_error: Network error — is the backend service running?
data.export_with_schema: This export includes {{count}} conversations and all settings, ready to import in the mobile app.
data.export_without_schema: The mobile app schema isn't registered, so the backup won't include conversations. Register it under “Mobile app compatibility” above first.
data.compat_summary: Mobile app database schema registered (version {{version}}, hash {{hash}}...). Desktop app exports are recognized by the mobile app.
data.unregistered_warn: The mobile app database schema isn't registered. Desktop app conversations can't be imported into the mobile app, and S3 / WebDAV backups won't include conversations.
data.current_format: Current format: version {{version}}, hash {{hash}}.... To update, re-upload a mobile app backup.
data.step1: In the mobile app, open Settings → Backup and export a .zip backup
data.step2: Click the button below and pick that .zip to upload
data.step3: The desktop app extracts only the schema (no data is imported)
data.storage_desc: Conversations, messages and memories live in one SQLite database (WAL mode): one row per memory, message nodes archived per conversation, plus full-text search. The counts below are read live from the database, not from JSON.
data.kelivo_desc: Import conversations, assistants, memories and more from a Kelivo backup; the range follows the Sync options card above.
data.kelivo_conversations_desc: Conversation list and message tree (desktop session DB + mobile-compatible DB)
data.kelivo_assistants_desc: Assistant settings, prompts and tags; the restore side uses them to re-home conversations
data.kelivo_models_desc: Providers, API keys, model lists and the selected model
data.kelivo_worldbooks_desc: Entries, trigger keywords and assistant bindings
data.kelivo_search_desc: API keys, common options and the selected service
data.kelivo_none_selected: Select at least one category to sync
data.kelivo_import_confirm: Import this Kelivo backup with the selected scope? Conversations with the same ID will be overwritten.
data.kelivo_export_toggle_desc: Local and cloud (WebDAV / S3) backups will also include a package Kelivo can restore directly; while enabled, “All data” is locked off and export follows the itemized selection only
data.kelivo_export_failed: Failed to download the Kelivo-compatible backup
data.kelivo_cloud_failed: Failed to upload the Kelivo-compatible backup: {{error}}
data.export_done_kelivo: Exported {{name}}; a Kelivo-compatible backup {{kelivo}} is in the same folder
data.backup_desc: Export a .zip (importable in the mobile app); its contents follow the Sync options card above. Import also accepts mobile app .zip backups, Kelivo mobile backups (assistants / conversations / memories) and legacy .json backups. Large backups may take 1-2 minutes.
data.sync_options_desc: Decides what local backups, WebDAV / S3 cloud backups, Kelivo-compatible packages and Kelivo imports include.
data.sync_options_global: This selection is global: every backup and sync below (local, WebDAV, S3, Kelivo) follows it, and unchecked categories stay untouched on restore.
data.sync_options_full_note: “All data” matches the original desktop backup: settings, conversations, attachments, skills, fonts and more are packed in one go. Local, WebDAV and S3 backups below all use the full backup.
data.sync_options_kelivo_lock: The Kelivo-compatible backup is on: it is generated from individual categories and cannot align with a full backup, so “All data” is locked off and only the itemized selection below is exported. Turn off the Kelivo-compatible backup to re-enable full backup.
data.sync_all_desc: Back up everything at once, like the original desktop app; uncheck to choose categories individually
data.backup_scope_attachments_desc: Images and files referenced by chats and avatars — usually the largest part of a backup
data.backup_scope_skills_desc: Installed Agent Skills (SKILL.md and its files)
data.restore_report_db_error: Conversation import failed: {{error}} (fell back to settings-only)
data.restore_report_nodes_skipped: {{count}} messages were skipped due to corrupted data in the backup
data.restore_report_files_deduped: {{count}} attachments matched existing content and were reused (no extra space used)
data.assistant_recovery_desc: {{count}} deleted assistants still have conversations on record — those conversations don't appear in any list. Recovering will create placeholder assistants to make them visible again; assistant settings like personas and models cannot be recovered.
data.assistant_recovery_done: Recovered {{count}} assistants — their conversations are visible again
data.webdav_desc: Test the connection, back up now, list remote backups, restore or delete. Backups match local exports: all settings, conversations, attachments, skills and fonts, importable in both the desktop and mobile apps.
data.no_remote_backups: No remote backups. Click “Refresh” to read the WebDAV directory.
data.no_remote_backups_s3: No remote backups. Click “Refresh” to read the S3 bucket.
data.s3_desc: Standard AWS S3 and compatible endpoints (MinIO/R2/Tencent COS/Alibaba OSS, etc.). Backup contents match WebDAV.
data.web_password_saved: Access password saved; reload to apply
data.web_password_locked: The access password is managed by deployment config (--password / RIKKAHUB_PASSWORD); change it there.
data.web_password_desc: Required when the app is accessed over the network (Web service / Docker / reverse proxy). Always set one before exposing the service.
data.web_listen_desc: The top field is the port you want; the rows below are what the process actually bound to. Point your reverse proxy at the actual values. Port changes take effect after a restart.
data.web_listen_port_desc: If the configured port is taken the app walks to the next usable one, so this shows the port really in use.
data.web_listen_hosts_desc: 127.0.0.1 / ::1 only means local access; binding 0.0.0.0 or a LAN address lets devices on the same network connect directly.
data.web_listen_upstream_desc: The address nginx / Caddy and friends should proxy_pass to.
data.web_listen_copy_failed: Copy failed — select the address manually
data.sandbox_desc: Limits the backend process to writing inside workspaces and its own data directory; everything else is read-only. Enforced by the Windows kernel; takes effect after restart.
data.sandbox_switch_hint: Once enabled, writes by the agent outside workspaces and the data directory are rejected by the operating system; workspace reads and writes are unaffected.
data.sandbox_measured_desc: Result of a probe file the backend writes outside workspaces at startup; stated separately from the toggle above.
data.sandbox_restart_pending: Saved. Restart the app to apply.
data.sandbox_save_failed: Failed to save the sandbox toggle
data.sandbox_container_hint: In container deployments the boundary comes from the mount table: mount workspaces :rw, everything else :ro or not at all, and keep the root filesystem read-only. This toggle does not apply.

s3.path_style_desc: Address buckets as endpoint/bucket (usually required for self-hosted services like MinIO); off uses bucket.endpoint virtual-host addressing.

hotkeys.send_on_enter_desc: On: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Off: the reverse.
hotkeys.reset_all_confirm_desc: All shortcuts and Send on Enter will be restored to their defaults.

codes.startup_failed: Startup bootstrap failed; app unavailable, restarting will retry
codes.unhandled_rejection: Unhandled promise rejection; process kept running
codes.pre_import_snapshot_failed: Pre-import settings snapshot failed; import continued without a local restore point
codes.restore_rolled_back: Backup restore failed; rolled back to pre-import state
codes.restore_rollback_failed: Backup restore failed and rollback errored; restart the app and verify settings and memories
codes.pc_db_unreadable: Desktop app conversation database in backup is unreadable; only settings were restored
codes.android_db_unreadable: Mobile app conversation database in backup is unreadable; only settings were restored
codes.no_conversation_db: Backup contains no conversation database; only settings were restored
codes.android_db_export_failed: Failed to build the mobile app conversation database; export will contain no conversations
codes.pc_db_export_failed: Desktop app conversation database export failed; restore will fall back to the mobile app format
codes.staging_failed: {{failed}}/{{total}} attachments failed to stage; backup is incomplete. First error: {{firstError}}
codes.attachments_missing: {{missing}}/{{total}} attachment source files are missing; not included in the backup
codes.memory_corrupt: Memory file corrupted; original quarantined and reset to default: {{file}}
codes.memory_write_failed: Memory write failed after 8 retries; latest change not saved: {{file}}
codes.live_db_snapshot_failed: Pre-import conversation database snapshot failed; import continued without a local restore point
codes.title_generation_failed: Auto title generation failed; fell back to the first message text
codes.auto_compact_failed: Automatic context compression failed; this turn continued with the original context
codes.recovery_adopted: Found rescue data from a previously failed save, newer than the main file; adopted automatically: {{source}}
codes.state_restored_from_backup: Settings file corrupted; restored from backup {{source}}, please verify your settings
codes.state_reset_default: Settings file corrupted with no usable backup; reset to defaults
codes.dedup_migration_failed: Attachment dedup migration failed; will retry on next launch
codes.memory_migration_backup_failed: Pre-migration memory backup failed; migration continued without a snapshot
codes.migration_residue_recovered: Found residue of a failed conversation migration; recovered {{count}} conversations from the snapshot, please verify
codes.conversation_migration_backup_failed: Pre-migration conversation backup failed; migration continued without a snapshot
codes.conversation_migration_failed: Conversation migration failed; data left untouched, will retry on next launch
codes.slim_state_after_migration_failed: Post-migration slim settings write failed; runtime unaffected
codes.live_db_unreadable: Conversation database unreadable; refilling from the migration backup
codes.live_db_refill_failed: Conversation database refill failed; conversation list is empty this launch, data remains in the migration snapshot
codes.state_save_failed_rescued: Settings save failed; rescue file written, auto-recovers on restart
codes.state_save_failed: Settings save failed and the rescue file could not be written; latest change not persisted
codes.daily_backup_failed: Daily settings backup failed; primary data unaffected
codes.slim_state_failed: Slim settings write failed; will retry on next launch
codes.hygiene_corrupt_cleaned: Data directory cleanup: removed {{count}} stale quarantined files
codes.hygiene_installers_cleaned: Data directory cleanup: removed {{count}} outdated update installer leftovers
codes.hygiene_legacy_snapshot_cleaned: Data directory cleanup: removed a legacy migration snapshot
codes.orphan_stats: Attachment stats: {{orphans}} entries no longer referenced (~{{orphanMb}} MB); {{untracked}} untracked files (~{{untrackedMb}} MB). Nothing is deleted automatically; back up first if you want to clean up
codes.hygiene_failed: Data directory cleanup task failed; harmless, will retry on next launch
codes.output_limit_unknown: The maximum output length for {{model}} is unknown; sent the conservative default {{fallback}}. If this model rejects it with an invalid max_tokens error, set the max output length manually in the assistant settings
codes.voice_provider_preserved: Detected voice services from the mobile app ({{types}}) that this desktop app doesn't support yet. Their configuration is preserved as-is for round-trip and won't be lost

model_edit.ability_tool_hint: When enabled, requests include the tools field
model_edit.ability_reasoning_hint: When enabled, requests include thinking/reasoning fields
model_edit.tool_image_generation_hint: OpenAI Responses injects the image_generation tool
model_edit.error_model_id_required: Model ID is required (sent verbatim as the upstream model field).
model_edit.error_header_name_missing: A custom header is missing its name. Fill it in or remove the row.
model_edit.error_body_key_missing: A custom body entry is missing its key. Fill it in or remove the row.
model_edit.desc_add: Configure an upstream model manually. The model ID must match what the upstream API expects.
model_edit.desc_locked: Fetched from the provider's model list. The model ID is locked (changing it would break request routing).
model_edit.desc_manual: Manually added model. All fields are editable.
model_edit.model_id_hint_locked: Locked. This is sent verbatim as the upstream model field; changing it would break requests.
model_edit.model_id_hint: The model string the upstream API accepts (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4).
model_edit.display_name_hint: UI display only. Never sent upstream.
model_edit.model_type_hint: Picks the upstream route: chat → chat/completions, image → image generation, embedding → /embeddings, rerank → /rerank.
model_edit.input_modalities_hint: Modalities other than text are metadata only today; they do not filter upstream requests.
model_edit.output_modalities_hint: With IMAGE checked, the OpenRouter path adds modalities=['image','text'] to the request body.
model_edit.not_chat_image: Image generation models do not use modality/ability fields.
model_edit.not_chat_embedding: Embedding models do not use modality/ability fields; requests go to baseUrl + /embeddings.
model_edit.not_chat_rerank: Rerank models do not use modality/ability fields; requests go to baseUrl + /rerank (Cohere needs …/v2, SiliconFlow, Jina and Voyage need …/v1).
model_edit.non_chat_endpoint_hint: If the provider's path does not follow the default convention, set a full baseUrl for this model under Advanced › Provider override.
model_edit.custom_headers_hint: Injected into every upstream request that uses this model.
model_edit.custom_bodies_hint: Deep-merged into the upstream request JSON. Use JSON syntax: quote strings, write numbers directly; objects/arrays are supported.
model_edit.provider_overwrite_hint: Give this one model its own baseUrl and API key. Requests for this model use this configuration instead of the parent provider's — typically for routing a model through a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway.
model_edit.json_parse_error: Not valid JSON; kept as a string. For objects/arrays, check the syntax.
model_edit.tools_chat_only: Built-in tools only apply to CHAT models.

font_picker.manage_desc: Upload custom font files (ttf / otf / woff / woff2), or delete uploaded ones. System and bundled fonts cannot be changed here.
font_picker.preview_cjk_text: 山映斜阳天接水，芳草无情，更在斜阳外。
font_picker.preview_mixed_text: Hello 你好, RikkaHub 2026 mixed-script Test 测试.
